This application for Listed Building Consent is being submitted concurrently with an application for Prior Approval under Class G (Part 3, Schedule 2 of the GPDO) for the change of use of the upper floors from commercial (Class E) to two self-contained residential units (Class C3).

The physical internal alterations detailed in this LBC application are specifically required to facilitate the delivery of the residential units proposed in the Class G application. As both applications are being submitted simultaneously, the reference number for the associated Prior Approval application is not yet available, but the two should be linked for assessment purposes.

A review of the site's history indicates that the property is a Grade II listed asset that has been largely vacant in recent years, managed under a 24-hour guardian arrangement to prevent deterioration of the historic fabric. There are no other known active applications or recent demolitions on the site.
description: Alterations to facilitate a change of use from commercial (Class E) to a mixed-use development comprising commercial space and two self-contained residential units (Class C3) including: 1) the installation of internal partitioning to create the residential layouts on the first, second, and loft floors; 2) the installation of sound insulation to floors and ceilings between the retained commercial ground floor and the new residential units above; 3) the installation of an automatic fire suppression system and fire-rated internal doors; 4) changes to the routing of internal plumbing and electrical services to support the kitchen and bathroom facilities.
